description: This file defines the class RoomMaintainer which implements the IRoomAdministrator interface for managing chat rooms, including methods for joining rooms, registering notifications, sending messages, and notifying users.

classes.name: RoomMaintainer
classes.description: Implements IRoomAdministrator for managing chat rooms, handling observers, room mapping, and synchronization.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Allows a user to join a specified room with a message notification sink.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for receiving room events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification sink.

methods.name: Exit
methods.description: Removes a user from a room.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to a room.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies a user in a room.
